target.meaning: The module selected by the door.

ok.meaning: Whether the selected module invocation completed successfully.

receiptPayload.meaning: Parsed child JSON or the unparsed key=value body.

rawChildStdout.meaning: The child output as returned by the crossing.

harmoniaReceipt.meaning: Wrapped child response, including its own firstMissingSignal. When a non-raw invocation is used the body stamps mutation=true even for the observe-only act.

first_missing_signal.meaning: Outer route signal: a JSON child first_missing_signal is copied here as well as into harmoniaReceipt. Its open forms may include module-unregistered-<id>, module-invalid <detail>, or <module_id>-<operation_id>-failed. For non-JSON key=value child output the outer signal is none or caduceus-harmonia-command-failed; harmoniaReceipt.firstMissingSignal parses the child and can include caduceus-harmonia-command-failed:<error text> or another child signal.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Fixed gate or request refusal signals; success ordinarily answers first_missing_signal instead. A gate refusal is a caduceus.staff.receipt.v1, not the successful leaf response; admission configuration errors are also fixed literals. The HTTP leaf is selected on homeconsole and specula; homeserver, homesi and hometv return caduceus-http-route-not-found instead of invoking the child.
